base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment explicitly uses SILAC with heavy 13C6,15N4-arginine to distinguish between light arginine and canavanine incorporation.

workflow: Amino acid labeling was performed as described by Ong and Mann... with heavy 13C6,15N4-arginine
we labeled arginine (Arg) with 13C615N4 to shift the masses of Arg-containing peptides by +10 Da to avoid the overlap with canavanine-containing peptides
Methionine oxidation, 13C6,15N4-arginine and canavanine (user defined) were set as variable modifications
differential: we identified 1589 peptide sequences containing canavanine... corresponding to 1980 canavanine sites
calculated the incorporation of light Arg, heavy Arg and canavanine as proportions of identifications and signals
search_parameters: Arg-to-canavanine substitution would result in a 1.9793 shift

we used endoproteinase LysC as the only protease

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is highly specialized, using SILAC not for traditional abundance quantification but as a mass-shift strategy to resolve the very small mass difference (27.3 mDa) between canavanine-containing peptides and the 3rd isotope of unmodified peptides. Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail without the specific canavanine mass shift (1.9793 Da) and the heavy Arg shift (10 Da) configured.
